entries.name: signRank_le_of_computableWithHeadsN
entries.note: T-grouping of cleared softmax score; decompose per P2.1-P2.4 (per-head A/B split, clearing, rank-by-subset, eta-shift). Needs Model/Head internals; rank subadditivity is now available as `rank_add_le` (P2.3) and outer-product rank via mathlib `rank_vecMulVec_le`.

entries.name: signRank_le_of_thresholdDegLE
entries.note: multilinearize on cube, group by left monomials into <= sum_{i<=d} C(a,i) rank-one pieces, eta-shift; the count sum_{i<=d} C(a,i) <= (a+1)^d is now the `sum_choose_le_pow` leaf (P3.3).

entries.name: forster
entries.note: decompose: r<N regime (P5.1, base estimate is the `card_le_specNorm_sq` leaf), general position (P5.2), isotropic position kernel (P5.3, compactness+first-order), main chain (P5.4). P5.3 is the deep analytic kernel.

entries.name: specNorm_signMatrix_distThreshold
entries.note: character eigenbasis diagonalizes M=s(x xor y): now scaffolded by `charFn`/`distSign` (proved `charFn_xor`) plus the leaves `signMatrix_distThreshold_apply`, `signMatrix_mulVec_charFn`, `charFn_orthogonal`, `distSign_sum_eq_zero`. Remaining core: level-1 eigenvalue bound (P4.2) + Parseval assembly (P4.3).

entries.name: thresholdDegLE_tensorDistThreshold
entries.note: product Q=(-1)^(k+1) prod_j P_j of block quadratics; degree<=2k via totalDegree_finsetProd; sign via the `sign_xor_prod` leaf (P8.2) and the per-block `blockSignRep_distThreshold` leaf (P8.4); k=0 gives Q=-1, G const false.

entries.name: theoremB_HStar
entries.note: needs HStar_comp_equiv (P1.3, new, Model internals) + sign-matrix Kronecker identity (P8.2) + signRank_reindex + signRank_neg + specNorm_kronecker (proved) + forster. Decompose per P8.1-P8.3.

entries.name: pow_le_of_leftShatters
entries.note: freeze left points, clear to Q_j in 2H shift vars (degree<=H, Model internals as in P2.1), eta-shift to strict sign patterns, Warren with m=2H,d=H,k polys; final algebra is the `warren_pow_simp` leaf (P10.1); case split H=0 (void), k<2H (trivial), k>=2H.

entries.name: rank_add_le
entries.note: Matrix.rank subadditivity (A+B).rank <= A.rank + B.rank; derive from (A+B).mulVecLin = A.mulVecLin + B.mulVecLin, range(f+g) <= range f sup range g, and finrank sup subadditivity (LinearMap.rank_add_le / Submodule.finrank_add_le_finrank_add_finrank). §11 inventory item 4.

entries.name: sum_choose_le_pow
entries.note: sum_{i in range(d+1)} C(a,i) <= (a+1)^d. Induction on d; step uses C(a,d+1) <= a*C(a,d) (Nat.choose_succ_right_eq) and C(a,d) <= sum <= (a+1)^d (term <= sum <= IH).

entries.name: card_le_specNorm_sq
entries.note: ±1 matrix ⇒ card ι <= (specNorm M)^2. specNorm M = ‖toEuclideanCLM M‖ >= ‖toEuclideanCLM M (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖; ‖M *ᵥ e_j‖^2 = sum_i (M i j)^2 = card. Empty ι via norm_eq_zero_of_isEmpty.

entries.name: sign_xor_prod
entries.note: XOR sign encoding e(XOR g) = (-1)^(k+1) * prod_j e(g_j), e(b)=if b then 1 else -1. Induction on k (or prod_j e(g_j) = (-1)^(#false) with #true+#false=k, and parity of #true = Odd(filter card)); k=0 both sides -1.

entries.name: blockSignRep_distThreshold
entries.note: strict degree-<=2 sign rep of z ↦ distThreshold m (blockOf z j) with nonzero cube values. Take the explicit Δ-m/2 polynomial from thresholdDegLE_distThreshold, apply MvPolynomial.rename (fun i => finProdFinEquiv (j,i)); eval_rename gives the block hammingDist - m/2 ∈ ℤ+1/2 (odd m).

entries.name: charFn_orthogonal
entries.note: sum_x charFn S x * charFn T x = if S=T then 2^m else 0. Rewrite summand as prod_i c_i(x_i) and use Finset.prod_univ_sum (sum/product interchange over the cube); each coordinate factor sum_b c_i(b) is 2 off S△T and 0 on it.

entries.name: signMatrix_distThreshold_apply
entries.note: signMatrix m m (distThreshold m) x y = distSign m (x xor y). Unfold signMatrix/distThreshold with leftBits_blockJoin/rightBits_blockJoin, then hammingDist x y = hammingDist (fun i => xor (x i) (y i)) (fun _ => false) (both count {i : x i ≠ y i}).

entries.name: signMatrix_mulVec_charFn
entries.note: eigen-action M *ᵥ charFn S = (sum_u distSign m u * charFn S u) • charFn S. (M χ_S)(x) = sum_y distSign(x xor y) χ_S(y) (via signMatrix_distThreshold_apply); substitute u = x xor y (Equiv from xor-by-x, involutive), then charFn_xor pulls out χ_S(x).

entries.name: distSign_sum_eq_zero
entries.note: sum_u distSign m u = 0 for odd m (this is λ_∅). Complement involution u ↦ (fun i => !u i) is fixed-point-free (m>=1) and flips the sign: |ū| = m - |u|, and for odd m exactly one of |u|,|ū| reaches (m+1)/2, so distSign ū = -distSign u; pair up via Finset.sum_involution / Equiv.

entries.name: warren_pow_simp
entries.note: (4*e*H*k/(2*H))^(2*H) = (2*e*k)^(2*H) for H>=1. Base equality: 4*e*H*k/(2*H) = 2*e*k by cancelling H≠0 (field_simp with (H:ℝ)≠0 from hH), then congr on the exponent.
